text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (My lungs are burning!)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And coming around the final corner from the outside is Narita Taishin! Looks like she's struggling to get a good position!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: She likely has no choice but to run on the outside. With her stature, it'll be impossible to escape the pack if she gets trapped inside.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: The racers are going all out in the final stretch! Number seven, Walkie Talkie, and number eleven, Poisonous, are battling for the lead!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And there's Narita Taishin! Here she comes! She's desperately trying to close in on the lead, but will it be enough?!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Crossing the finish line, it's number eleven! Poisonous claims first! Wow, listen to those cheers echoing through the racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Aw, Narita Taishin got fifth? She just can't get a break.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Can you blame her? Even the commentator said she's at a disadvantage.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: I mean, just look at how small she is.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (Not another one of those dreams.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh. This is the worst…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yaaawn… Taishin? What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Whoa, Creek!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Uh, it's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Having trouble sleeping? Want to drink some hot milk with me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I-I'm fine! I'm gonna step out for a sec.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sorry for waking you up. Later.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Goodness me…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sigh…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (I feel better now, but I'm still a little restless. I keep having those horrible dreams lately.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (And I've got my debut race coming up soon…)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Maybe it's because my debut is almost here.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (Dammit. Now's really not the time to be doubting myself!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today's the day my journey to tackle the Twinkle Series with Narita Taishin begins!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm going to do my best for her and bring out the full potential of her final sprint!
choice_data_list: (Okay, time to roll up my sleeves!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hey, it's time to start training. What are you doing standing there like a tool?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ew, what's with that sappy, starry-eyed look?
choice_data_list: Taishin! Let's give it our all starting today!
Taishin! Let's give it our all starting today!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Man, you're annoying…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, whatever. Let's just get started already.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin is as cool as ever today… However!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Raaah!
choice_data_list: (Incredible! That final sprint of yours is really something else!)
(Incredible! That final sprint of yours is really something else!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huff, wheeze… Phew.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: How was my time?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah? Then…
choice_data_list: We'll stun them all at your debut!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Easy for you to say. You're too chill about this.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Do you actually understand what the Twinkle Series is like?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Tracen is filled with god-tier racers, and even then, only a select few from here qualify to compete in it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: That's the kind of race we're facing.
choice_data_list: And your running will be just as good as theirs!
And your running will be just as good as theirs!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sigh. You airheaded birdbrain.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: First of all, just "stunning" everyone's not gonna cut it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I have to use my skills to thrash anyone who talks smack about size.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: That'll make every last one of them think twice about me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Narita Taishin's fierce declaration marks the beginning of her new challenges.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh, can you do something about that vibe of yours? It's overkill, and you're seriously getting on my nerves.
